subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to New York. Your flight details are as follows: Flight number: ABC123, Departure: Date & Time, Arrival: Date & Time. Please remember to check in online 24 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We look forward to welcoming you on board! Best regards, The Airline Team
